_about: The trial switches of Orb's trial build: switches that are off on main and on in the build Orb plays (node tools/desktop-local-build.mjs --trial). Owner-private only; a testers' package is always exactly main. One row a switch: id, what it is in plain words, owner, and the data key it flips: file (under data/ or ui/data/), path, from (main's value), to (the trial's value); `more` for further keys of the same switch ({path, from, to, file?}); `needs` for rows that must be on with it. A switch has to be a value in a data file: the build reads it back out of the built program, and a constant inside a script cannot be read there. Add a row in the same change that lands the switch; take it out when main turns it on (tools/trial-switches.mjs --check says so). Check: node tools/trial-switches.mjs --check.

rows.what: the Settings row Split screen (Later, Standard, Sooner): how soon the screen splits
